tips.text: Bring a beam or wide-AoE primary like an Ignis for the spinning targets; the puzzle, not Kela's health, is the time sink.
Go invisible or into Operator Void Mode during Orbital Strikes and ignore them.
Swap off Viral; Kela is immune to it.
Farm a second Systems blueprint if Chroma is next; her Systems needs a built Saryn Systems.
Run Kela now instead of waiting on Saryn's Circuit week; missing it means an 11-week wait.
Make sure every squad member holds 25 Judgement Points; anyone short is kicked at load with no warning.
Run Kela two or three times, do something else, then come back.
Expect Kela to fall through the map at low health now and then; it soft-locks the fight.
Most players call it a mildly annoying farm of 6 to 12 kills, and the boss itself is liked.
